decisions.reason: As a distant, niche extension with no later website presence, this line is likely to have fallen below aspiration levels after its trial period, making resource reallocation to core lighting activities the more likely choice.

Although adjacent to the firm's capabilities, the specialised medical segment likely requires stronger dedicated demand and channels than the firm’s core business, so weak comparative results would now favor withdrawal.

Explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's industrial and maritime customer base and its certified engineering strengths, so management would likely continue the line unless results clearly disappoint.
Despite being close to the established offer, a relaunched designer task light that no longer appears visibly promoted would be vulnerable if sales only matched or fell below aspiration levels.
A pendant office luminaire is closely aligned with the firm’s core professional building and workplace lighting business, so organisational slack and strategic fit support continued retention.

This premium pendant line remains close to the established range and can support the firm’s position in tailored, higher-quality lighting solutions, so management would likely keep it while monitoring performance.
